<thought>We need the retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the sulfonamide product “CC(=O)C=Cc1ccccc1NS(=O)(=O)Cl”, breaks the N–S bond and gives the two precursors reported earlier: the amine fragment “CC(=O)C=Cc1ccccc1” and the sulfonyl‑chloride fragment “OCl”. By testing each candidate template returned from the catalog search, the template with ID 437773 correctly produces exactly those two precursors. Its stored mapped reaction SMILES (forward direction) is the required answer.</thought>
